body: Read-only Mote localization for the 31-candidate regression: /Users/bbuchsbaum/code/rust/mote/src/state.rs around 1534 iterates self.candidates.values() for exact-pair freshness with no phase filter. Thus superseded cand-70GX remains a mandatory reciprocal pair and makes every older producer receipt stale, while reducer forbids new evidence on non-pending cand-70GX. This is an impossible state by construction. Narrow remedy candidate: exclude phase Superseded and Abandoned from pair-freshness iteration while retaining Pending and landed phases for ancestor safety; add a regression court where a newer candidate is superseded after an older candidate was landable and the older remains landable without impersonating its evidence producer.
